author: OpenAI Codex
statement: For the charged raw crossing pieces, a scalar pairing on a D-dimensional output space must vanish if the sum of the intermediate partition-space dimensions for its supported shifts is less than D. In particular, at output energy h and dimension at least p(h)/poly(h), support only at absolute shifts at least (1+epsilon)h forces zero scalar pairing for fixed positive epsilon and all sufficiently large h. This does not exclude filters with intermediate shifts or improve a SAT bound. Separate linear mixtures on the input axes, including the predecessor local normalization, remain single pieces by bilinearity.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size rank argument and inherited two-order identity
The wider central-gap target allows intermediate shifts and is not excluded
Nonseparable joint label mixtures must be charged by their number of separable pieces
No complete SAT algorithm or improved selected bound
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent or formal review
